title: All Disco, All Dan
tagline: Four clubs, twelve stages and one night to light every disc!
blurb: Four clubs, twelve stages and one night to light every disc! Hop Dan on the beat to build your Groove, fill the Funk Meter and let rip a Boogie Point to leave Ron the bouncer and Flat-Note Fred dancing on the spot. Race the cassette counter in Showtime or take it easy in Chill Groove.

quote.text: The title page then gives you the keys, the mode and the music switch without any fuss

credits.name: Norm Crabtree, Baz Pocket and Prue Fairley for INK & PAPER

shots.caption: Thirteen on the counter and the mirrorball has gone red. Panic stations in the Velvet Basement.

shots.caption: Flat-Note Fred, stopped dead by a Boogie Point. Best thing for him.

shots.caption: TWO RONS! All that gold is only a promise: the floor goes back to plain the moment you start.

shots.caption: All five take a bow on the roof, including the two who spent all night undoing your good work.
